10.title: Add Interchain Labs validator
10.message: The Interchain Foundation stewards a vast ecosystem of decentralized technologies. We develop and maintain foundational protocols, and fund organizations to create an internet of shared resources, security, and value creation.

11.title: Add Blockscout validator
11.message: Blockscout is a robust open-source tool for exploring, confirming, and inspecting transactions on any EVM blockchain. This proposal adds them as a validator to the network.

12.title: Add Enigma validator
12.message:
We are Enigma, a professional infrastructure provider supporting over 50 blockchain networks and offering a wide range of services, including public infrastructure, indexing solutions, analytics, and community services.

Our team has been delivering public infrastructure support for XRPL for some time now, providing resources such as public RPC/LCD endpoints , daily updated snapshots and addrbook.

13.title: Add RHINO validator
13.message:
RHINO

Jeff and I have over 30 years in the infrastructure and security space. Today, we secure a bit more than $450M in TVL across more than a dozen networks, including Aptos, Sei, dYdX, and others. We run bare-metal infrastructure out of 2 RHINO-owned data centers in the US, combined with an additional 4 clusters of nodes in Germany, Singapore, Tokyo and soon in the Middle East. Our security policies and ISMS are extensive, providing significant layers of security protocols to protect our operations - public or signing.

In addition to validation services, we run some of the largest RPC arrays in the space for Foundations including Sei, Aptos, Seda, and Chainlink. We serve just about 30B requests/month to over 200 DeFi, NFT, bridge, social and other teams for those projects.

Our infrastructure and monitoring is built based our experience, and has significant security, resiliency and monitoring to afford any outage - at a hardware, signer, node, provider or region. We run just redundant, geo-distributed nodes for just over 60 chains, including Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Polygon zkEVM, ZKSync, Scroll, Mode, XLayer and more. We'd very much like to apply our expertise, network and effort to XRPL EVM!

14.title: Add kingnodes validator
14.message:
Our Australian owned and operated company, King Blockchain Pty Ltd operates validators and blockchain infrastructure as “Kingnodes” across the blockchain landscape.
 
We are proud to operate our own hardware racked in a tier-4 datacentre located in Brisbane, Australia, as well as a fleet of rented/leased bare metal hardware across the globe.
 
We have been in operation since late 2020 and operate validators on 15+ mainnet networks including Injective, Sei, dYdX, among others. We also operate associated blockchain infrastructure and services for a raft of cosmos SDK and EVM compatible blockchains. We provide B2B services such as high quality, distributed RPC systems for enterprise customers such as dYdX, as well as to individual teams. Our robust archive nodes and backup/snapshot solutions has provided blockchain history security to many chains in this time.
 
With our years of experience, we have developed resilient and comprehensive monitoring and alerting solutions for our operation and boast response times from the on-call engineer, on average, less than 1 hour.
 
We look forward to working with you all, and couldn’t be prouder to be here amongst long time friends, as well as fresh faces.

33.title: Add Keplr validator
33.message: Keplr is the largest wallet in the Cosmos ecosystem, serving over 2 million users. We support both EVM and non-EVM chains, including Celestia, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Starknet. Beyond wallet services, Keplr maintains RPC infrastructure for 45 Cosmos-based chains and has been a validator for 17 chains over the past three years, consistently ranking among the top 10 Cosmos validators by stake size.Our robust infrastructure spans over 100 servers across five cloud and bare-metal providers, ensuring high stability and performance.

34.title: Protocol upgrade to v8.0.0
34.message: This proposal will execute a protocol upgrade to the version 8.0.0 (https://github.com/xrplevm/node/releases/tag/v8.0.0)

35.title: Add Range validator
35.message:
Hello XRPL EVM Community,
We at Range would like to contribute to the XRPL EVM Testnet. We've spun up a node and are now looking to take the next step by joining the active validator set. As a team with extensive experience in running blockchain infrastructure, we’re enthusiastic about contributing to the growth and stability of the XRPL EVM ecosystem. We are looking to integrate XRPL EVM into our public explorers and extend support across the tooling and infrastructure we maintain at Range.
If we are allowed to run a testnet validator, we kindly request a small amount of poa tokens to initiate validator promotion.

36.title: Add CryptoCrew validator
36.message:
CryptoCrew Validators is an Austrian-based Web3 infrastructure provider specializing in secure, transparent validation, IBC relaying and node services. 

Since 2021, we have secured over USD 40 million across 40+ interchain networks and facilitated millions of IBC transactions. Our global network of decentralized bare-metal servers is protected by enterprise-grade security and monitoring, backed by a 24/7 on-call operations team.

As a core protocol contributor we maintain strategic partnerships with foundations and liquid staking protocols. After winning the 2022 Game of Chains Testnet Program on the Cosmos Hub, we now support Interchain Security Solutions and onboarding for consumer chains.

CryptoCrew Validators has received an AAA rating as a Verified Staking Provider on stakingrewards.com: https://www.stakingrewards.com/provider/cryptocrew-validators
